spans.s:
वेल् 1. वेल् (rather to be regarded as a
Nom. fr. वेला below), cl. 10. P. वेल-
यति, -यितुम्, to count or declare the time.

वेल, अम्, n. a garden, grove; (आ), f. time, season,
(वेलायाम्, seasonably); opportunity, interval, leisure;
tide, flow, stream, current; the coast, sea-shore,
(वेलायाम्, on the sea-shore, coast-wise); boundary,
limit; speech; passion, emotion, feeling; easy or
painless death (= अक्लिष्ट-मरण); sickness, dis-
ease, (according to Śabda-k. = राग-स्थाने रोगः);
the gums; the food of Śiva (= ईश्वरस्य भोजनम्);
N. of a daughter of Meru and wife of Samudra; of
the wife of Budha.
—वेलाकुल (˚ला-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
agitated by the tide.
—वेला-कूल, अम्, n. ‘stream-
bank,’ N. of a district (the modern Tāmalipta or
Tumlook, see ताम-लिप्त; said to be in the district
of Midnapore or in the southern part of the present
Hūglī district, forming the west bank of the Hūglī
river at its union with the sea; a village called Beer-
cool, said to be derived from Velā-kūla, is still found
near the sea-shore).
—वेला-मूल, अम्, n. the sea-
shore.
—वेला-वन, अम्, n. a wood on a shore or
sea-coast.
—वेलावली (˚ला-आव्˚), f., N. of a particular
scale in Hindū music.
—वेला-वित्त, अस्, m. (thought
to be) a kind of judicial office.

वेल्ल, अस्, m. going, moving; shaking; (अस्, अम्),
m. n. a particular plant (the seed of which is used as
a vermifuge (= विडङ्ग).
—वेल्ल-ज, अम्, n. black
pepper, Piper Nigrum.

वेल्लन, अम्, n. going, shaking; rolling on the
ground (as a horse &c.); a sort of rolling-pin with
which cakes &c. are prepared; (ई), f. a species of
Dūrvā grass (= माला-दूर्वा).
वेल्लन्तर, अस्, m. a particular tree (= वीर-तरु).
वेल्लहल, अस्, m. a libertine (= केलि-नागर).
वेल्लि, इस्, f. a creeping plant; [cf. वल्लि.]

वेल्लिका or वेल्लिकाख्या (˚का-आख्˚), f. a plant
(commonly called Bel Suṇṭh).

वेल्लित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, trembling, tremulous;
crooked; (अम्), n. going, moving; shaking.

वेलिभुक्प्रिय वेलिभुक्-प्रिय, अस्, m. a kind
of fragrant mango.
